## Invitations

The outreach activity invited 1530 people, of whom 238 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 15.6 per cent. The result provides a clear indication of participation among those invited and supports ongoing review of how invitations are planned and delivered.

Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring. This seasonal pattern should be considered when interpreting participation levels and when planning future outreach activity. Allowing for these variations may help provide a more balanced assessment of engagement across the year.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 1293 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 1293 people, maintaining consistent follow-up with those contacted by text message. The use of both invitations and reminders supported communication with the intended audience and provided an additional prompt before the activity.

Prepared by G. Evans.
